```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ggpmisc)
library(ggh4x)
```

Load SBS, DBS, ID and get mutation count
```{r}
sbs <- data.table::fread("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/matGen/ds_filtered/output/SBS/UC_AA.SBS96.all") %>% column_to_rownames(var = "MutationType") %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% 'colnames<-' ("SBS") %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples")
dbs <- data.table::fread("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/matGen/ds_filtered/output/DBS/UC_AA.DBS78.all") %>% column_to_rownames(var = "MutationType") %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% 'colnames<-' ("DBS") %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples")
id <- data.table::fread("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/matGen/ds_filtered/output/ID/UC_AA.ID83.all") %>% column_to_rownames(var = "MutationType") %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% 'colnames<-' ("ID") %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples")

```

```{r}
## Process data for plotting
combined_res <- sbs %>% left_join(x = ., y = dbs, by = "Samples") %>%
  left_join(x = ., y = id, by = "Samples") %>%
  gather(data = ., key = "class", value = "value", -Samples) %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(grepl("_Blood", Samples) ~ "B",
                          grepl("_Urine", Samples) ~ "U",
                          grepl("_Kidney", Samples) ~ "N",
                          grepl("T", Samples) ~ "T",
                          grepl("N", Samples) ~ "N"),
         group = gsub(pattern = "_Urine|_Blood|_Kidney|T|N", replacement = "", x = Samples)) %>%
  mutate(Samples = case_when(grepl("_Blood", Samples) ~ gsub(pattern = "_Blood", replacement = "B", Samples),
                             grepl("_Urine", Samples) ~ gsub(pattern = "_Urine", replacement = "U", Samples),
                             grepl("_Kidney", Samples) ~ gsub(pattern = "_Kidney", replacement = "N", Samples),
                             TRUE ~ Samples)) %>%
  mutate(perMB = value / 48000 * 1e6) ## Count to perMB

## Factor order
sample.order <- c("UC2", "UC4", "UC5", "UC7", "UC10", "UC11", "UC13", "UC14", "UC18", "UC19", "UC26", "UC34")
combined_res$group <- factor(x = combined_res$group, levels = sample.order)
combined_res$type <- factor(x = combined_res$type, levels = c("T", "N", "B", "U"))
combined_res$class <- factor(x = combined_res$class, levels = c("SBS", "DBS", "ID"))

## Prepare data for snake plot
snake_df <- combined_res %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  arrange(perMB, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  mutate(
    x = rank + (cur_group_id() - 1) * max(rank)
  )

## Color annotation
color_anno <- c("#A6A6A6", "#4F81BD", "#D7191C", "#FDAE61")
names(color_anno) <- c("N", "T", "B", "U")

## Alternating grey and white background for the 3 mutation class
bg_df <- data.frame(
  xmin = c(-0.5, 32.5, 64.5),
  xmax = c(32.5, 64.5, 97.5),
  fill = c("grey95", "white", "grey95")
)

## Compute the median for each mutation class
med_df <- snake_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(class) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    med = median(log10(perMB + 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

p1 <- ggplot(snake_df, aes(x = x, y = log10(perMB+1))) +
  geom_rect(
    data = bg_df,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = bg_df$fill,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(color = type), size = 0.5) +
     geom_segment(x = 16.5 - 12, xend = 16.5 + 12,
             y = 3.69, yend = 3.69,
             color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.2) +
   geom_segment(x = 48.5 - 12, xend = 48.5 + 12,
             y = 1.86, yend = 1.86,
             color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.2) +
   geom_segment(x = 80.5 - 12, xend = 80.5 + 12,
             y = 2.38, yend = 2.38,
             color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_anno) +
  ylab(expression("log"[10]*"(Mutation per MB)")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(16.5, 48.5, 80.5),
                     labels = c("SBS", "DBS", "ID"),
                     expand = expansion(add = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank())
```
